content:
The **Hornwright Air Purifier Site #04** is a location in the Ash Heap region of Appalachia.

Located due north of the town of Beckley, this site is one of four locations where Hornwright Industrial set up their Air Purifiers. This was the site chosen to display the new technology to the public. [1] 

This site contains a single building up the hill which contains a locked level 1 Explosives Crate, a Combat Shotgun, and assorted junk. Scavengers may be poking through the filing cabinets.

A small campsite has been set up to the north of the site where Janelle and Raymond Priblo were preparing to hunt the fabled Beast of Beckley.

The *Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide* states that some "tinned crab meat" can be found in the area. [Pub 1] While not incorrect, the kind of meat gets randomized from a list of raw meats. It can be found on the shelf next to the broken water cooler in the shack.

The Hornwright Air Purifier Site #04 appears in *Fallout 76*.
